summary.name: Smart Gift AI
summary.one_liner: Smart Gift AI is a free AI gift finder that recommends personalised gift ideas based on a recipient's age, interests, occasion and budget, linking to Amazon products.
use_cases: Finding a birthday gift for a parent or friend
Picking Christmas gifts for a team with different budgets
Narrowing gift options by occasion and price range
Comparing ranked gift matches side by side
Getting gift ideas for someone who has everything
summary.what_it_does: The site describes a gift finder where the user enters the recipient's age, relationship, occasion, budget and optional interests. It says a language model generates search keywords, searches Amazon inventory in real time, and returns a ranked list with match scores, ratings and direct Amazon links. Results can be saved to a wishlist without creating an account. The page also states it filters by budget and covers occasions such as birthdays, Christmas, anniversaries and Valentine's Day. It also hosts a set of AI gift guide articles.
notable: Ranked gift matches with match scores, ratings and direct Amazon links
No account or login required; wishlist saving without sign-up
States results are not ordered by paid placement and contain no sponsored results
Budget filtering from under $25 to over $500
caveats: Relies on live Amazon inventory, so results depend on Amazon's catalogue
Match accuracy and user testimonials are self-reported marketing claims (e.g. 99.8% accuracy) not independently verified
